dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: I'm currently reading the works of some bards.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: They weave their ideas, thoughts, and truths into romantic poetry, not at all like the unwieldy tomes of Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Perhaps this romanticism is an expression of great wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Sayid
dialogues.text: Yes, this is excellent. Excellent material, indeed.
